title: PluginHealthChangedPayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'plugin.health-changed'. Loombre Plugin Protocol (LPP) v1, Lane W2 (LD4/LD7): emitted in the SAME transaction as a plugins.health_state column change (packages/db/src/query/plugins.ts's setPluginHealthAndEmit), exactly on a state TRANSITION — never on a health check that reconfirms the same state. envelope.actorUserId is always null (system-originated: health checks run without a human actor in the loop). ADMIN-ONLY delivery, mirroring settings.updated exactly.

pluginId.description: The plugins.id row whose health_state changed.

changedAtMs.description: Epoch ms of the health check that produced this transition.
